The expert witness also stated the Mental Health Act was not applied appropriately. Namely, whilst Mr Wells was technically an informal patient, the clinicians recognised that he would be detained if he tried to leave i.e. he was 'de-facto' detained without the additional resources and safeguards applicable to a detained patient being put in place.
